name: Linc Ltd-$
title: Linc Ltd-$ - 531241 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 margins squeezed by polymer costs (EBITDA margin 8.7%, down 89 bps YoY); management withholds guidance again, passing on only ~50% of price hikes, with no capacity signals.

triggers.label: Only ~50% of price hike passed on
triggers.quote: we could pass on around 50% of the price hike to the trade. But we have not passed on the entire increase.

triggers.label: No formal guidance; wait till Q2
triggers.quote: we would like to wait for a few months. Maybe in the second quarter call, if we have some better visibility

triggers.label: Corporate sales down 14% YoY
triggers.quote: Corporate sales declined by 14% against a high base in the previous year

prior_guidance_check.quote: await another quarter to gain better visibility before providing formal guidance on our outlook

red_flags.label: Margin compression, no guidance
red_flags.quote: Operating EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR1,209 lakhs with an EBITD A margin of 8.7% representing a Y-o-Y contraction of 89 bps.

summary.headline: Linc Q1 FY27 operating income rose 1.4% YoY to INR13,895 lakhs, but EBITDA margin fell 89 bps to 8.7% and PAT margin fell 93 bps to 4.2%; no guidance given.
summary.overview: Management described Q1 FY27 as a stable quarter despite geopolitical uncertainty and elevated polymer input costs. Operating income grew 1.4% YoY to INR13,895 lakhs, with e-commerce (+32%) and general trade (+8%) offsetting a 14% fall in corporate sales and a 3% fall in exports. Operating EBITDA was INR1,209 lakhs (8.7% margin) and PAT was INR581 lakhs (4.2% margin), both down YoY on polymer costs. Management said polymer prices are easing, but withheld formal guidance until the Q2 call.

segments.name: Corporate sales
segments.commentary: Declined 14% YoY against a high prior-year base; management says it is requirement-based and lumpy, not structural.

segments.name: Export
segments.commentary: Declined 3% YoY, attributed to geopolitical impact on global trade flows.

segments.name: General trade
segments.commentary: Grew 8% YoY, cited as steady brand-building and distribution progress.

segments.name: E-commerce (incl. LINC On)
segments.commentary: Grew 32% YoY, with an increasing contribution from LINC On, the e-commerce subsidiary.

segments.name: JV: UNI-LINC (with Mitsubishi Pencil, Japan)
segments.commentary: Operationally stable; exports above 50% of its revenue in the quarter.

guidance_outlook: No formal guidance for FY27 or margins; management will wait until the Q2 FY27 call for better visibility.
Polymer prices are easing and management expects them to normalise over coming quarters; management says the worst is behind but the outlook is uncertain.
West Bengal manufacturing facility (linked to Morris of Korea subsidiary) expected to be operational by Q3 FY27.
Kenya subsidiary sales momentum improving; LINC On expected to gain momentum; ramp-up slower than initially envisaged.
capex_capacity: New manufacturing facility in West Bengal, linked to the Morris of Korea subsidiary, expected to become operational by Q3 FY27.
No capacity utilisation or capex figures were disclosed in the call.
demand_pricing: Market share unchanged QoQ, as the whole industry faced raw material availability issues and higher input costs.
Company passed on about 50% of the polymer-driven price hike to the trade; the rest is not yet passed on and there is no immediate plan to pass it on.
Another price hike will be decided after observing raw material prices for another quarter.
Margin pressure came from higher polymer prices (supply constraints and higher crude), partly offset by cost management.

qa_highlights.question: How have market shares trended, and have price hikes been taken to offset commodity inflation (how much passed on vs. yet to pass on, and margin impact)?
qa_highlights.answer: Market share unchanged in the quarter as the whole industry faced raw material shortages and cost inflation. About 50% of the price hike was passed to the trade; the balance is not being passed on immediately, and a further hike will be decided after another quarter of observing raw material prices.

qa_highlights.question: What is the long-term revenue growth guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: No revenue growth guidance was given; management will provide an outlook in the Q2 call once visibility improves.

qa_highlights.question: What is the steady-state margin guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: No margin guidance was given because the situation is volatile; management will revisit this on the Q2 call.

risks_watch: Polymer and crude price trajectory; management expects normalisation but has not committed to timing.
Remaining ~50% of the price hike not yet passed on to the trade, which limits margin recovery.
West Bengal facility commissioning by Q3 FY27, which gates the Morris of Korea subsidiary's development.
Corporate sales volatility and the 3% export decline amid geopolitical trade disruption.
Slower-than-planned ramp-up at the Kenya subsidiary and LINC On.
summary.management_tone: Cautious and non-committal: management called the environment volatile and declined to give revenue or margin guidance until Q2. It was more confident on polymer prices easing and on long-term foundations, while acknowledging that the international ramp-up has taken longer than planned.
key_quotes: Given the current uncertainties, we believe it will be prudent to await another quarter to gain better visibility before providing formal guidance on our outlook.
While the ramp-up of these initiatives has taken a little longer than initially envisaged, we believe the foundations bei ng established are robust and well considered.
